newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares weaker, comms probs hit trade.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares weaker, comms probs hit trade.

text.p: 1710 GMT - Portuguese shares closed weaker in light turnover of 5.4 billion escudos after trade was delayed by four hours due to computer problems with the Tradis trading system this morning. The market accompanied the weakness of foreign bourses and Portugal Telecom was heavily penalised, dropping back to 6,250 escudos, down three percent from yesterday's close.

* Dealers said that the Lisbon bourse could weaken tomorrow if Wall Street closes lower. "If New York continues this downward trend, the mood of the Lisbon market will remain unchanged. The fear of a rise in U.S. interest rates weighed on markets again," said one operator.

* Sonae Investimentos could be an active stock tomorrow in anticipation of its 1996 results due to be announced next Monday. Dealers said the expected 1996 consolidated net profits of 18 to 20 billion escudos were already incorporated in the share price.
